title: National Youth Smoking Reduction Act
subjects: Department of Health and Human Services

committees.name: Health, Education, Labor, and Pensions Committee

actions.text: Sponsor introductory remarks on measure. (CR S4016-4017)
Read twice and referred to the Committee on Health, Education, Labor, and Pensions.

latest_action.text: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Health, Education, Labor, and Pensions.

summaries.text: National Youth Smoking Reduction Act - Amends the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act to give the Secretary of Health and Human Services regulatory authority over tobacco products.Amends the Federal Cigarette Labeling and Advertising Act to revise tobacco and smokeless tobacco label and advertising warning requirements.Makes any advertising that violates this Act an unfair or deceptive act or practice under the Federal Trade Commission Act.
